entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac... I, um, I need to make a return. I ordered a jersey a while back and it just... it doesn't fit. I'm so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited for this one. It’s just the wrong size for me.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF88602 now... I see the Pro-Series Jersey, delivered about 64 days ago. Can you tell me what's wrong with the fit?

It's just too tight across the shoulders. I really can't even ride in it comfortably. I was hoping I could still send it back. With things being so expensive lately, I really needed that money for something that fits.

I completely understand. Let me just check the policy for you... And yes, good news. For a standard item like this jersey, you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. We can absolutely get this processed for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Could I do an exchange for a larger size instead of a refund?
Of course. An exchange is no problem at all. I can process that for you right now and email you a pre-paid return label for the one that's too tight. How does that sound?
That sounds wonderful! Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. I've just processed the exchange. You'll see that label in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
